llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with an e-commerce review analysis tool, but it relies on browser automation and runtime package installs which require the user to trust the agent with their logged-in browser/session and installed packages.

dimensions.detail: Name and description claim multi-platform review extraction and analysis; declared requirement (python3) and suggested dependencies (jieba, python-docx, fpdf2) match text analysis and report generation needs. 'needsBrowser' and browser automation are expected for scraping reviews from Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs use of browser automation and 'smart login' (QR assistance). That is within scope for scraping reviews, but it implies access to the user's logged-in browser session and any data visible there. The instructions (as shown) do not reference unrelated files or environment variables, but the agent will operate in the user's browser context which could expose cookies, session data, and other open-site information.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec. SKILL.md lists pip packages to install (jieba, python-docx, fpdf2). Installing runtime Python packages via pip is reasonable for the task but introduces standard supply-chain risk (malicious/malfunctioning PyPI packages) if performed automatically.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The lack of extra credential requests aligns with the stated purpose (scraping via the user's logged-in browser).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not 'always' enabled and does not request elevated persistence. It is user-invocable and allows autonomous invocation by default (platform normal), which is expected for skills and reasonable here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for extracting and analyzing reviews, but be aware of two practical risks before installing: (1) Browser automation and 'smart login' require access to your logged-in session (cookies, pages you have open). Only run this skill when you are comfortable the agent can access the account(s) involved, and avoid providing raw account passwords if possible—prefer scanning QR codes locally. (2) The skill suggests installing Python packages at runtime (jieba, python-docx, fpdf2). If the agent will perform pip installs automatically, consider auditing which packages will be installed and run them in a sandboxed environment. If you need higher assurance, request the full SKILL.md (untruncated) and any runtime commands the agent will execute, and test first with a throwaway account or in a controlled environment.
